# Getting help

- **Using the app:** email [info@algorythmos.com.au](mailto:info@algorythmos.com.au) with the
  subject `PDF Algo Pro support`. The app is not released yet; once it is, **Settings → Help →
  Report a problem** will let you attach an optional diagnostics summary (never your documents).
- **A security problem:** follow [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md). Don't open a public issue.
- **A bug or idea for this repository:** open an issue with the bug or feature template.

We aim to reply to support email within two business days.
